prompt: A man in his twenties with an absurdly sharp, square jaw leans in close to a webcam on a dim bedroom desk, chin lifted, one corner of his mouth pulled up in a sneer and his eyelids lowered with total confidence. The image is a soft, slightly over-compressed frame from a cheap laptop camera, with a wide-angle lens distorting his nose and forehead a little. Behind him is an unmade single bed with a grey duvet and a clothes airer hung with socks, and the only light is a bluish glow from the screen on his face plus a thin bar of orange streetlight leaking round a curtain edge. Muted, slightly washed-out colour and soft digital noise in the shadows. Thanks.
